'''Gram Seiglo''' was an alias used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents to check into a suite in the [[Imperial Hotel (Lianna)|Imperial Hotel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] where they met their contact [[Terri Karl]].
